Bats can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] from [[Turael]], [[Spria]], and [[Mazchna]]. They have a requirement of level 5 [[combat]] to be assigned and are generally meant as tasks for beginners. There are a variety of bats, but the most commonly killed are regular [[bat]]s and [[giant bat]]s. Bats only drop [[bat bones]] or nothing at all, meaning there is little reason to slay higher-level bats.

Although they are called bats, [[dire bat]]s in [[Vampyrium]] do '''not''' count towards this Slayer task.
